source: Beats and part ids: briefing_parts.json steps. Lines: services/preop/src/briefing.ts (coach brief.<stepId>), verbatim. Peeled = layer <= peelThroughLayer plus peel ids; the small bowel is peeled so the appendix is visible.

steps.title: Landmarks and incision site
steps.line: First, find the hip bone and the belly button. A third of the way along that line is McBurney's point. Mark five to eight centimeters along the skin lines.

steps.title: Skin incision
steps.line: One smooth stroke along your mark, through skin and fat only.

steps.title: Open the aponeurosis
steps.line: Under the fat is the external oblique aponeurosis. Open it along its fibers, never across them.

steps.title: Split the muscles
steps.line: The internal oblique and transversus come next. Split them with two retractors. Pull, don't cut, so the muscle keeps its nerves.

steps.title: Open the peritoneum
steps.line: Lift the peritoneum with forceps so the bowel falls away, then nick it.

steps.title: Deliver the appendix
steps.line: Find the cecum, follow its taenia to the appendix, and lift it gently out into the wound.

steps.title: Divide the mesoappendix
steps.line: The appendicular artery runs in the mesoappendix. Clamp twice, cut between, and tie both sides. No bleeding before you move on.

steps.title: Ligate and divide the base
steps.line: Find the true base where the taeniae meet. Crush it, tie within five millimeters of the cecum, and cut above your tie.

steps.title: Check the field
steps.line: Suction the field dry and check the stump and the tied vessels.
